headline: KPI Green Energy Limited incorporates Wholly Owned Subsidiary
sum: KPI Green Energy Limited has incorporated a Wholly Owned Subsidiary (WOS), disclosed to NSE on 19 June 2026; no acquisition consideration or subsidiary name stated in the filing.
detail: KPI Green Energy Limited, a renewable energy company listed on NSE, formally notified the exchange of the incorporation of a new wholly owned subsidiary. The intimation was filed on 19 June 2026 but the disclosure document does not specify the subsidiary's name, registration number, business purpose, or whether the WOS is a precursor to a named acquisition. This is a routine corporate governance filing; the economic substance of the subsidiary's role will emerge in subsequent announcements or regulatory filings.
